svg.title: Intrepid - orthographic oblique - original illustrative schematic
svg.desc: Intrepid transseptal EFS implant | 48 mm outer / 27 mm inner representative. Distal +Z: left ventricular outflow; -Z: left atrial inflow. Fixed orthographic projection. Original parametric geometry; mesh, proportions and repeated features simplified. Not to scale. Technical review only; human signoff pending. See SOURCES.md.
